arms.name: direct_scribble
arms.role: post-hoc exploratory (added by user decision 2026-11-04 after stage 1)

arms.name: instance_repair_count_matte_soft
arms.role: strongest reviewed OCSD route; foreground_screen settings

negative: blurry, low quality, distorted, deformed, watermark, text
primary_endpoint: Per image, from the blind review: structure success = count, colour and shape all pass.
analysis: Unit = scene (18); each arm's structure success rate per scene = mean over its two seeds.
Primary: exact two-sided sign test on scenes where the two arms differ, Holm-corrected over the two primary tests; report rates with 95% bootstrap CIs over scenes.

Secondary: naturalness 0/1/2 means, most-natural picks, OWLv2 count accuracy/OPR/count error/mIoU/relations/joint layout success and CLIP, all with paired bootstrap CIs over scenes; no p-values beyond the two primary tests.
direct_scribble comparisons are exploratory and labelled post-hoc everywhere.
Results by object-count bin (3, 5, 8+) are descriptive only.
Cost per arm: wall time, UNet/ControlNet/GLIGEN sampling calls and peak memory, reported per architecture, not as equal FLOPs.
No reruns, extra seeds, tuning or image selection on these scenes; failed or missing images are reported.
limits: InstanceDiffusion is an external method (Wang et al., CVPR 2024).
Inputs are instance-separated sketches with phrases and boxes.
QuickDraw drawings come from the same first-3000-record pool as the paper benchmark (new generator seed, new scenes).
